entities.summary: Han Yoo-mi is a South Korean volleyball player. She was part of the silver medal winning team at the 2010 Asian Games. She was also part of the South Korean team that came fourth at the 2012 Summer Olympics. She was part of the South Korea women's national volleyball team at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Japan. She played with Korea Volleyball Association.
